title: Offer to enable Bluetooth if disabled when trying to join a Bluetooth connection
line: Saved Bluetooth networks now stay in the Networks applet while Bluetooth is off, and Connect turns Bluetooth on and connects.
explanation: NetworkManager only creates the device for a Bluetooth network (phone tethering) while the Bluetooth adapter is powered, so with Bluetooth off the saved connection had no device. The applet hides connections without a device, and the settings page lists it as unavailable with Connect greyed out, so there was no way to connect and no hint why. Now the handler watches Bluetooth through BluezQt (rfkill block and adapter power, like the Bluetooth applet's own switch); while Bluetooth is off the applet keeps saved Bluetooth connections listed with "Bluetooth is off" under them, and the settings page offers "Turn On Bluetooth and Connect". Connecting unblocks and powers the adapters, waits up to 15 s for NetworkManager's device for that phone to become ready, and activates the connection on it.

commits.message:
applet: offer to turn on Bluetooth to connect to Bluetooth networks

Saved Bluetooth connections were hidden in the applet and couldn't be
activated from the settings page while Bluetooth was off. Now they stay
listed, and connecting turns Bluetooth on first and then activates them.

BUG: 416868

media.caption: Bluetooth is off: the saved "Pixel 8 Network" tethering connection is missing from the Networks applet.
With the fix it is listed with "Bluetooth is off"; clicking Connect turns Bluetooth on and connects.
Settings page: Connect is greyed out for the Bluetooth connection while Bluetooth is off.
With the fix the menu offers "Turn On Bluetooth and Connect", which turned Bluetooth on and connected.
